title: Prompt-Activation Duality: Improving Activation Steering via Attention-Level Interventions
abstract: arXiv:2605.10664v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Activation steering controls language model behavior by adding directions to internal representations at inference time, but standard residual-stream steering can fail in stateful dialogue. We identify KV-cache contamination as a key failure mode: steered token states are stored and repeatedly reused, turning a local perturbation into cumulative coherence degradation. To address this challenge, we propose Gated Cropped Attention-Delta steering (GCAD), which extracts steering signals from system-prompt contributions to self-attention and applies them with token-level gating. Across persona-steering experiments, GCAD preserves trait control while substantially improving long-horizon coherence. On the main multi-turn benchmark, GCAD improves average coherence drift from -18.6 to -1.9 and raises turn-10 trait expression from 78.0 to 93.1. These results suggest that activation steering becomes more reliable when interventions follow

translated_title: 提示-激活对偶性：通过注意力层面的干预改进激活引导
translated_abstract: 激活引导通过在推理时向内部表示添加方向向量来控制语言模型的行为，但标准的残差流引导在有状态对话中可能失效。我们识别出KV缓存污染是一个关键的失效模式：被引导的token状态会被存储并反复重用，使局部扰动演变为累积性的连贯性退化。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了门控裁剪注意力增量引导，该方法从系统提示对自注意力的贡献中提取引导信号，并通过token级别的门控机制加以应用。在人格引导实验中，GCAD在保持特质控制的同时显著提升了长程连贯性。在主要的多轮基准测试中，GCAD将平均连贯性漂移从-18.6改善至-1.9，并将第10轮的特质表达从78.0提升至93.1。这些结果表明，当干预遵循提示与激活之间的对偶性时，激活引导会变得更加可靠。
tldr: 该论文揭示了残差流激活引导在有状态对话中因KV缓存污染而失效的机制，并提出GCAD方法，通过从系统提示的注意力贡献中提取信号并进行token级门控干预，在保持人格特质控制的同时大幅改善多轮对话的长程连贯性。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies KV-cache contamination as the key failure mode of residual-stream activation steering in stateful dialogue and proposes GCAD, an attention-level intervention that extracts steering signals from system-prompt contributions to self-attention with token-level gating, preserving trait control while substantially improving long-horizon coherence in multi-turn conversations.
